clauses.title: The autofix driver stops on a moved target before every gate
requires: // Before every gate and at final readiness: the target, the operator capture, the workspace, the body, and the issue
const moved = targetMoved(t, pull); if (moved) end(run, 'BLOCKED', moved);

clauses.title: The record states target stability
requires: The target identity is re-resolved before every gate invocation and must be unchanged; anything else stops the run without mutation, and nothing is cleaned or switched to make the check pass.
